desc: Parse N and the N×N character grid; build adjacency lists for outgoing edges and incoming edges (reverse adjacency) with labels.
BFS on product graph of size N×N: initialize distance array with -1, push all (k, k) with distance 0.
BFS transition: for current state (u, v), iterate over (x, c1) in out[u] and (y, c2) in inc[v]; if c1 == c2 and dist[x][y] is -1, set dist[x][y] = dist[u][v] + 1 and push (x, y).
After BFS, print the N×N distance matrix (dist[i][j] for i,j in 0..N-1, adjusting indices). Distances already represent answer (0 when i==j, otherwise shortest palindrome path length or -1).
Test the solution with the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
If outputs match, the solution is complete.
